verdict.rationale: AvaTax has an official MCP server exposing tax calculation, transaction lookup, nexus data, and AI-powered tax code recommendations, enabling natural-language/agentic interaction via MCP-compatible clients (e.g., 'Calculate tax for a $100 sale...' as a natural-language-style example). However, this is an API/MCP layer for developers rather than a native conversational UI for end users, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming robustness of natural-language command handling. missing for 10: independent or hands-on validation of natural-language command execution, evidence of a first-party conversational interface beyond MCP tool calls, and confirmation of reliability/accuracy of the AI-powered recommendations in practice.
